correctness.rationale: The zonotope volume formula expresses each volume as a sum of absolute maximal minors. For \(s\ge0\), every minor containing the scaled generator contributes linearly in \(s\), while every other minor is constant. Fresh independent determinant enumeration recovered the four coefficient pairs \((4,10),(12,18),(8,18),(24,32)\). Multiplication gives exactly \(4s(2-s)\), so the all-real sign classification is analytic. Appending independent coordinate segments is a Cartesian product with a unit cube and preserves all four volumes.

final_claim: Scaling the special generator in Skorupinski's four-dimensional zonotope gives volumes \(4+10s,12+18s,8+18s,24+32s\) and defect \(4s(2-s)\); log-submodularity fails exactly for \(0<s<2\), is sharp at \(s=0,2\), and holds strictly for \(s>2\), with the same phase diagram in every dimension at least four by Cartesian product.
limitations: Only this natural one-generator deformation ray is classified.
No claim is made about the full multi-parameter generator-scaling region.
